flows.representativeInput: Fixture with tests.focused "pnpm test {files}" and check inputs tests/a.test.ts, tests/b.test.ts; implementer and reviewer startup; plus a template with no {files}. focusedCommand at payload/.joycraft/runtime/dispatch-start.mjs:50
flows.expected: commands.focused = { command: "pnpm test tests/a.test.ts tests/b.test.ts", argv } for both roles; files appended when the template has no {files}.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-5-1] passes in the 3/3 run (exit 0): both roles print the exact command and argv; "npx vitest run" gets the files appended.

Probe (payload installed via dist/cli.js init): reviewer and implementer startup exit 0 and print focused {command:"node tests/a.mjs tests/b.mjs", argv:[...]} in queue order. With a check path containing a space, argv stays correct ("tests/a b.mjs") but the command string is unquoted (see spec-5-2).

flows.representativeInput: Fixture startup for both roles; each printed command run exactly as printed through /bin/sh -c from the worker root, in a plain root, a root with a space ("my proj") and a check input with a space ("tests/a b.mjs"). workerCommands at payload/.joycraft/runtime/dispatch-start.mjs:67-77
flows.expected: Entries evidence, submit (implementer), checkReport and finalizeReview (reviewer); none matches the forbidden pattern; each runs as printed from the worker root, paths with spaces included (paste-ready per brief worker-commands).

observations.actual: [AC:spec-5-2] passes: entries present, none matches /&&|;|\||\$\(|<<|\bsource\b|\bcd\b/, and the receipt path is accepted by evidence.mjs.

Plain root: every command is plain and runs as printed (evidence exit 0, submit exit 0, check-report and finalize-review parse and stop only on the absent report). Root with a space: the printed checkReport embeds the absolute --worker-root unquoted and fails as printed: "Dispatch stopped: Invalid or duplicate argument: docs/features/2026-11-21-f/specs/review-1.report.json" (exit 1). Check input with a space: the printed evidence command "... -- node tests/a b.mjs" splits the path and the run exits 1, and commands.focused.command is not a runnable string. No entry matched the forbidden pattern in any fixture.

flows.representativeInput: Fixtures without tests.focused and with tests.focused but no check inputs; implementer startup
flows.expected: commands.focused is null with a note naming the missing piece; startup exits 0.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-5-3] passes: no config gives a note naming tests.focused, no checks gives a note naming the check input; both exit 0.

findings.summary: Printed commands interpolate paths without shell quoting. With a worker root that contains a space (common on macOS), the printed checkReport fails as pasted: "Invalid or duplicate argument" (receipt spec-05-probe.log). The same applies to a check input path with a space in focused.command and the evidence step (dispatch-start.mjs:61, :71), and to queue/report/receipt paths. Fix: quote any word that is not [A-Za-z0-9_./:=@%+,-]+ with single quotes (escape embedded quotes) when building each string; single quotes do not hit the forbidden pattern. Alternatively print --worker-root . for check-report if it accepts a relative root. Add a fixture with a space in the root and in a check path.

{files} is replaced only as a whole word; a template like "vitest --dir={files}" or a quoted argument in the template is split on whitespace and gets the files appended instead. The spec does not decide it.
findings.assumption: Whole-word {files} is the documented form, so this does not fail spec-5-1.

findings.summary: The receipt stamp has second resolution, so two startups of the same role and spec within one second print the same receipt path. Rare; adding milliseconds would make it always fresh.
Reviewer evidence receipts go to <feature>/receipts/, while this feature's reviewers write to <feature>/reviews/receipts/. Both are under the feature folder, as the spec asks; consider one place.

limits: Installed .joycraft/runtime/dispatch-start.mjs in this checkout is the pre-change copy (its startup printed no commands); the payload copy was reviewed and exercised through fixture installs.
Probe runs commands through /bin/sh -c, which matches how a pasted command is split; the Claude Code worktree guard itself was not invoked.
